executive_summary.overall_assessment: ActiveLog Technologies demonstrates a mature and well-implemented information security program. The organization shows strong commitment to security with comprehensive controls, regular monitoring, and continuous improvement processes.
key_strengths: Strong technical controls and monitoring capabilities
Regular security training and awareness programs

audit_scope.testing_approach: Combination of automated scanning, manual testing, interviews, and document review

Security policies updated annually with appropriate approval processes

findings.finding: Comprehensive risk assessment methodology aligned with business objectives
